title: Lower bound 1 for every ball-density limit of an integer multiplicity weight at almost every point
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with weight μ := R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then the following holds for μ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P. Whenever θ₀ ∈ ℝ and μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n)) → ofReal(θ₀) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0, θ₀ ≥ 1. Here ω_n = unitBallVolume n and B_ρ(x) = ball x ρ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ θ : ℝ, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal θ)) → 1 ≤ θ
